outcome: Activated Kupffer cells in liver (F1 offspring)
cohort: Twenty-eight F0 mother mice were randomly allocated to control, ZnO NPs, ZnO NPs + OJ, or OJ groups, and their F1 pups and F1 mature offspring were studied.
finding: Exposure to ZnO NPs in F0 mothers induced teratogenicity and hepatotoxicity in F1 pups, F0 mothers, and F1 offspring, respectively, with fresh orange juice acting as a remedial agent against these toxicities.
gest_age: Pups recovered via cesarean section were obtained on the 18th day of gestation.
